source.releaseTimeReview: THC-ENC-216–220 were reviewed for asynchronous seed maturation, multifactorial sex-expression instability, photoperiodic reversion, genotype-dependent visual maturity indicators, and chain-of-identity seed records. Public wording avoids universal seed-harvest percentages, single-stressor intersex diagnoses, fixed revegetation timelines, universal trichome/stigma harvest thresholds, and unsupported pedigree certainty.
source.note: This batch completes controlled Volume 11 — Flowering & Reproduction — through seed maturity, reproductive stability, reversion, flower senescence, and traceable reproductive records.
